items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 13:1
items.html: (To the question) The third aspect is Mochin. And if in the posterior Partzufim, they are Mochin of VAK, for all the Ibur, Yenika, and Mochin of the posterior are only VAK outward, being only the completion of the vessels. And there are two aspects in these Mochin: if from the upper Aba and Ima, then from them is the aspect of the Mochin in their place; and if from YESHSUT, they are only the aspect of the illumination of the head from above downward, namely by the bowing of the head of ZA down to the place of his HGT, and the Nukva takes the Mochin from the place of the HGT. (Item 16).
